title: GTA 6 Leaker Releases New Gameplay Videos Despite Subpoenas
description: According to IGN Games, the alleged GTA 6 leaker has released two more gameplay videos despite Take-Two subpoenas targeting Microsoft and Discord.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leaker Defies Take-Two Subpoenas with New Gameplay Footage

The security surrounding Rockstar Games' highly anticipated *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to face severe challenges. According to a recent report by IGN Games, the alleged GTA 6 leaker has defied ongoing pressure from Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, by releasing two additional gameplay videos.

### Legal Pressure and Continuing Leaks

Prior to this latest development, Take-Two took aggressive legal steps to track down the source of previous leaks by issuing subpoenas to tech giants Microsoft and Discord. These subpoenas were aimed at obtaining identifying information regarding the individuals responsible for the security breaches. In the gaming industry, such measures signal a zero-tolerance approach from publishers attempting to protect their intellectual property and control the marketing narrative.

Despite these legal maneuvers, the new footage—consisting of two gameplay videos—has surfaced online. Because these clips originate from unverified channels rather than Rockstar Games itself, they highlight the persistent difficulty that major publishers face when dealing with digital leaks and online distribution networks.

The ongoing situation underscores the intense public curiosity surrounding *GTA 6*, alongside the complex challenges of maintaining development secrecy in the modern digital landscape where communication platforms like Discord and tech ecosystems like Microsoft's play central roles.

## Editor's Take

The latest report from IGN Games highlights an ongoing tug-of-war between Take-Two's aggressive legal enforcement and persistent unverified leakers. While subpoenas targeting Microsoft and Discord show the publisher's determination to track down offenders, the appearance of new gameplay videos proves that stopping online leaks remains a monumental challenge. Players should approach these unauthorized clips with caution and wait for official updates from Rockstar Games.
